image_description: A close-up shot of a person's upper chest and neck area wearing layered jewelry. The primary subject is a multi-strand necklace featuring dark blue faceted beads on thin chains, with a large, round, ornate pendant containing clear stones (likely diamonds or crystals) in a gold-tone setting at the center. There are also two metallic collar-like accessories or chokers visible on the sides: a twisted silver/gold piece on the left and a smooth gold bar on the right. The background is the person's skin and a dark navy or black garment at the bottom.
